message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Polish all three chapters in academic English: unify \"trajectory track/trajectory method\" to \"trajectory tracking\", unify \"outside/beyond this range\" to \"beyond this range\", fix the run-on/ungrammatical appendix sentence by splitting it into two sentences, and reword the controller's \"claim\" to the authors' perspective. Formulas (\\tau=0.5) and \\ref{fig:tracking} are unchanged.

hunks.oldText: Our trajectory method has a clear weakness: it degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} reports the comparison.
hunks.newText: Our trajectory-tracking method has a clear weakness: its performance degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} reports the comparison.

hunks.oldText: We study trajectory tracking under the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. The controller does not claim robustness beyond this range.
hunks.newText: We study trajectory tracking under the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. We do not claim robustness for the controller beyond this range.

hunks.oldText: The proof use same trajectory track restriction $\tau=0.5$ and it not claim robustness outside this range.
hunks.newText: The proof uses the same trajectory tracking restriction $\tau=0.5$. It does not claim robustness beyond this range.
